notes: Migrations are exact SQL statements stored in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations.
RPC definitions are pg_get_functiondef snapshots from the connected database at extraction time.
Schema/ files are reconstructed from catalog, not original historical migrations.
No table rows, authentication credentials, or database dump included.
GitHub commit tree contained no original .sql or supabase/migrations directory.
This is not guaranteed to be an executable all-in-one restore.
